+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Group inference for NARPS AO86 equal-indifference participant gain effects."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+import nibabel as nib
+from scipy import stats
+from scipy.ndimage import label
+from nilearn import datasets, image, plotting
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+DATA = ROOT / 'input' / 'data'
+OUT = ROOT / 'results'; FIG = ROOT / 'figures'
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True); FIG.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+N_PERM = 10000
+SEED = 20261016
+ALPHA = .05
+
+# Cohort lock: exact participant set from supplied TSV, sorted by identifier.
+meta = pd.read_csv(ROOT / 'input' / 'participants.tsv', sep='\t')
+paths = sorted(DATA.glob('*_hypo1_cope.nii.gz'))
+by_id = {p.name.split('_')[0]: p for p in paths}
+ids = sorted(meta.participant_id)
+assert len(ids) == 54 and set(ids) == set(by_id) and len(paths) == 54
+imgs = [nib.load(str(by_id[s])) for s in ids]
+ref = imgs[0]
+assert all(im.shape == ref.shape and np.allclose(im.affine, ref.affine) for im in imgs)
+arrays = np.stack([im.get_fdata(dtype=np.float32) for im in imgs])
+finite = np.isfinite(arrays).all(axis=0)
+# Supplied effects use zero for outside-brain voxels. Common nonzero support avoids
+# comparing different participant coverage; a standard MNI152 brain mask excludes
+# non-brain edge/background voxels from whole-brain inference.
+nonzero = np.all(arrays != 0, axis=0)
+brain = image.resample_to_img(datasets.load_mni152_brain_mask(resolution=2), ref,
+                              interpolation='nearest').get_fdata() > .5
+mask = finite & nonzero & brain
+X = arrays[:, mask].astype(np.float64)
+n, v = X.shape
+assert n == 54 and v > 10000
+
+# QC: spatial coverage, global distribution and subject-level summary.
+qc = []
+for i, sid in enumerate(ids):
+    a = arrays[i]
+    vals = a[mask]
+    qc.append({'participant_id':sid, 'age':int(meta.set_index('participant_id').loc[sid,'age']),
+               'gender':meta.set_index('participant_id').loc[sid,'gender'],
+               'nonzero_voxels':int(np.count_nonzero(a)), 'common_mask_mean':float(vals.mean()),
+               'common_mask_sd':float(vals.std(ddof=1)), 'common_mask_min':float(vals.min()),
+               'common_mask_max':float(vals.max()), 'n_nonfinite':int((~np.isfinite(a)).sum())})
+pd.DataFrame(qc).to_csv(OUT/'participant_qc.tsv',sep='\t',index=False)
+
+# One-sample positive-direction t test. Participants are the independent units.
+mean = X.mean(axis=0)
+sd = X.std(axis=0, ddof=1)
+t_obs = mean / (sd / np.sqrt(n))
+df = n - 1
+p_unc = stats.t.sf(t_obs, df)
+
+# One-sided whole-brain max-T sign-flip permutation test. Sign flips are valid
+# under the null of symmetric participant-level errors; each permutation's maximum
+# t controls family-wise error over every voxel in the common-support mask.
+rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
+max_t = np.empty(N_PERM, dtype=np.float32)
+# Batch multiplication uses optimized BLAS and avoids storing permuted volumes.
+for start in range(0, N_PERM, 100):
+    b = min(100, N_PERM-start)
+    signs = rng.choice(np.array([-1.,1.]), size=(b,n))
+    sums = signs @ X
+    # sign flipping preserves each participant's squared observation
+    ss = np.sum(X*X, axis=0)[None,:] - (sums*sums)/n
+    var = np.maximum(ss/(n-1), 0)
+    tp = (sums/n) / np.sqrt(var/n)
+    max_t[start:start+b] = np.max(tp, axis=1)
+    del signs, sums, ss, var, tp
+max_t_sorted = np.sort(max_t)
+# Search each observed t against the sorted permutation maxima to avoid a
+# permutations-by-voxels temporary array.
+p_fwe = (1 + (N_PERM - np.searchsorted(max_t_sorted, t_obs, side='left'))) / (N_PERM + 1)
+pd.DataFrame({'permutation':np.arange(1,N_PERM+1), 'max_t':max_t}).to_csv(
+    OUT/'permutation_max_t.tsv.gz',sep='\t',index=False,compression='gzip')
+
+# Save maps on source grid with zero outside common support.
+def save_map(vals, name, dtype=np.float32):
+    out = np.zeros(ref.shape, dtype=dtype)
+    out[mask] = vals
+    nii = nib.Nifti1Image(out, ref.affine, ref.header)
+    nii.set_data_dtype(dtype)
+    nib.save(nii, OUT/name)
+    return nii
+mean_img = save_map(mean, 'mean_gain_effect.nii.gz')
+t_img = save_map(t_obs, 'tstat_one_sample.nii.gz')
+p_volume = np.ones(ref.shape, dtype=np.float32)
+p_volume[mask] = p_fwe
+p_img = nib.Nifti1Image(p_volume, ref.affine, ref.header)
+p_img.set_data_dtype(np.float32)
+nib.save(p_img, OUT/'p_fwe_maxT.nii.gz')
+logp_img = save_map(-np.log10(np.maximum(p_fwe, 1/(N_PERM+1))), 'neglog10_p_fwe.nii.gz')
+
+# Independent atlas label supports the anatomical localization. Harvard-Oxford
+# cortical atlas, 25% max-probability; vmPFC operationalization: Frontal Medial
+# Cortex label restricted to y >= 0 and z <= 0 in MNI coordinates. This is an
+# explicit ventral medial subset, not a region used to select whole-brain results.
+atlas = datasets.fetch_atlas_harvard_oxford('cort-maxprob-thr25-2mm')
+atlas_img = image.resample_to_img(atlas.maps, ref, interpolation='nearest')
+labels = [str(x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else x) for x in atlas.labels]
+frontal_idx = next(i for i, label in enumerate(labels) if label.lower() == 'frontal medial cortex')
+atlas_dat = atlas_img.get_fdata().astype(int)
+ijk = np.indices(ref.shape)
+xyz = nib.affines.apply_affine(ref.affine, np.moveaxis(ijk,0,-1))
+vm_mask = mask & (atlas_dat == frontal_idx) & (xyz[...,1] >= 0) & (xyz[...,2] <= 0)
+vm_idx = np.flatnonzero(vm_mask[mask])
+vm_fwe_sig = p_fwe[vm_idx] <= ALPHA
+
+# Label significant whole-brain voxels and identify overlap with anatomical ROI.
+sig = p_fwe <= ALPHA
+sig_vol = np.zeros(ref.shape, dtype=bool)
+sig_vol[mask] = sig
+coords = np.column_stack(np.where(sig_vol))
+world = nib.affines.apply_affine(ref.affine, coords) if len(coords) else np.empty((0,3))
+cluster_labels, n_clusters = label(sig_vol, structure=np.ones((3,3,3), dtype=int))
+cluster_rows = []
+for cluster_id in range(1, n_clusters+1):
+    vox = np.column_stack(np.where(cluster_labels == cluster_id))
+    tv = t_img.get_fdata()[cluster_labels == cluster_id]
+    peak = vox[np.argmax(tv)]
+    peak_world = nib.affines.apply_affine(ref.affine, peak)
+    cluster_rows.append({'cluster':cluster_id,'voxels':len(vox),'peak_t':float(tv.max()),
+                         'peak_x':float(peak_world[0]),'peak_y':float(peak_world[1]),
+                         'peak_z':float(peak_world[2])})
+pd.DataFrame(cluster_rows).to_csv(OUT/'fwe_clusters.tsv',sep='\t',index=False)
+sig_roi = bool(np.any(vm_fwe_sig))
+roi_mean = float(np.mean(mean[vm_idx])) if len(vm_idx) else float('nan')
+roi_median_t = float(np.median(t_obs[vm_idx])) if len(vm_idx) else float('nan')
+roi_max_t = float(np.max(t_obs[vm_idx])) if len(vm_idx) else float('nan')
+roi_max_p = float(np.min(p_fwe[vm_idx])) if len(vm_idx) else float('nan')
+roi_mean_t = float(np.mean(t_obs[vm_idx])) if len(vm_idx) else float('nan')
+# An interpretable unthresholded ROI summary with t-based CI; descriptive, not the
+# inferential basis for hypothesis support.
+roi_data = arrays[:, vm_mask]
+subject_roi = roi_data.mean(axis=1)
+roi_se = subject_roi.std(ddof=1)/np.sqrt(n)
+roi_ci = stats.t.interval(.95, df, loc=subject_roi.mean(), scale=roi_se)
+
+summary = {
+ 'n_participants':n, 'n_voxels_common_mask':int(v), 'mask_rule':'finite and nonzero in all 54 maps, intersected with resampled MNI152 2 mm brain mask',
+ 'permutations':N_PERM, 'seed':SEED, 'test':'one-sided positive one-sample t; sign-flip max-T whole-brain FWE',
+ 'minimum_attainable_p':1/(N_PERM+1), 'whole_brain_fwe_alpha':ALPHA,
+ 'n_fwe_significant_voxels':int(sig.sum()), 'n_fwe_significant_clusters_26conn':int(n_clusters),
+ 'n_positive_voxels_uncorrected_p_lt_05':int(np.sum((p_unc < .05) & (t_obs > 0))),
+ 'max_t_whole_brain':float(np.max(t_obs)), 'min_p_fwe_whole_brain':float(np.min(p_fwe)),
+ 'permutation_max_t_range':[float(max_t.min()),float(max_t.max())],
+ 'significant_peak_mni_mm':(world[np.argmax(t_obs[np.flatnonzero(sig)])].round(1).tolist() if np.any(sig) else None),
+ 'vmPFC_roi_definition':'Harvard-Oxford cortical Frontal Medial Cortex max-probability 25%, MNI y>=0 and z<=0; descriptive localization only',
+ 'vmPFC_n_voxels':int(vm_mask.sum()), 'vmPFC_mean_across_voxels_effect':roi_mean,
+ 'vmPFC_subject_mean_effect':float(subject_roi.mean()), 'vmPFC_subject_mean_95ci': [float(roi_ci[0]),float(roi_ci[1])],
+ 'vmPFC_mean_t_across_voxels':roi_mean_t, 'vmPFC_median_voxel_t':roi_median_t,
+ 'vmPFC_max_voxel_t':roi_max_t, 'vmPFC_min_voxel_p_fwe':roi_max_p,
+ 'vmPFC_max_voxel_p_uncorrected':float(np.min(p_unc[vm_idx])) if len(vm_idx) else None,
+ 'vmPFC_has_fwe_significant_voxel':sig_roi,
+ 'all_subject_maps_finite':bool(np.isfinite(arrays).all()), 'excluded_participants':[],
+ 'subject_mean_effect_range':[float(subject_roi.min()),float(subject_roi.max())],
+ 'subject_global_sd_range':[float(np.min([q['common_mask_sd'] for q in qc])),float(np.max([q['common_mask_sd'] for q in qc]))]
+}
+(OUT/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
+pd.DataFrame({'voxelwise_t':t_obs,'p_uncorrected':p_unc,'p_fwe_maxT':p_fwe,'mean_effect':mean}).to_csv(OUT/'voxelwise_results_common_mask.tsv.gz',sep='\t',index=False,compression='gzip')
+
+# Whole-brain visual: display unthresholded t and FWE significant voxels.
+# MNI template is only a background for localization.
+template = datasets.load_mni152_template(resolution=2)
+# Positive-direction uncorrected display only. Whole-brain support is assessed
+# from the max-T family-wise corrected results above.
+pos_unc_img = save_map(np.where(t_obs > stats.t.ppf(.95,df), t_obs, 0),
+                       'tstat_positive_uncorrected_p05.nii.gz')
+plotting.plot_stat_map(pos_unc_img, bg_img=template, threshold=0, display_mode='z',
+                       cut_coords=[-24,-12,0,12,24,36,48], cmap='hot',
+                       title='Positive gain effect: uncorrected p < .05 (display only)',
+                       colorbar=True, output_file=str(FIG/'whole_brain_t_uncorrected.png'))
+# Save corrected effects separately. An all-zero map means none pass.
+sig_img = save_map(np.where(sig, t_obs, 0), 'tstat_fwe_significant.nii.gz')
+plotting.plot_stat_map(sig_img, bg_img=template, threshold=0, display_mode='z',
+                       cut_coords=[-12,-8,-4,0,4,8,12], cmap='hot',
+                       title='Positive gain effect: whole-brain max-T FWE p ≤ .05',
+                       colorbar=True, output_file=str(FIG/'whole_brain_fwe.png'))
+
+# Anatomical ROI descriptive estimate plot; one participant is one point.
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.2,4.6))
+ax.axhline(0,color='0.5',lw=1)
+ax.scatter(np.arange(1,n+1), subject_roi, s=24, alpha=.75, edgecolor='none')
+ax.axhline(subject_roi.mean(),color='#b2182b',lw=2,label=f'Mean {subject_roi.mean():.3f}')
+ax.fill_between([1,n], roi_ci[0],roi_ci[1],color='#b2182b',alpha=.14,label='95% t interval for mean')
+ax.set(xlabel='Participant (sorted ID)',ylabel='Mean gain-effect estimate in vmPFC mask',
+       title='Participant-level vmPFC summaries (descriptive)')
+ax.set_xlim(.5,n+.5)
+ax.legend(frameon=False); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(FIG/'vmPFC_subject_estimates.png',dpi=180); plt.close(fig)
+print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))

+def run(argv,allow=False):
+    p=subprocess.run(list(map(str,argv)),cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True)
+    commands.append({'argv':list(map(str,argv)),'returncode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr})

+        text='# '+prepared['run_id']+'\n\nCoordinator navigation for this stopped experiment. Original scientific files are copied unchanged from its captured delivery.\n\n'
+        text+='\n'.join('- ['+p+']('+quote(p,safe='/')+')' for p in links)
+        text+='\n\nThe [complete original archive](coordinator/delivery-01/delivery.tar.gz) remains authoritative. See the [copy manifest](coordinator/browsable-copy-01/manifest.json) for source hashes and storage, and [coordinator records](coordinator/README.md) for preservation provenance. This navigation adds no scientific execution or worker credit.\n'
+        (repo/'README.md').write_text(text)
+        cmd=pixi+['pre-commit','run','--config','/Users/johnlee/code/CON/stamped-in-practice/.pre-commit-config.yaml','snapper','--files','README.md']
+        if run(cmd,allow=True).returncode:run(cmd)
+        paths.append('README.md')
+    if (root/'root-review-01.json').exists():
+        dest=evidence/'review/root-review-01.json';dest.parent.mkdir();shutil.copy2(root/'root-review-01.json',dest)
+        paths.append(str(dest.relative_to(repo)))
+    shutil.copy2(Path(__file__),evidence/'add-navigation.py');paths.append('coordinator/browsable-copy-01/add-navigation.py')
+    result={'coordinator_root_readme_added':not original_readme,'original_root_readme_preserved':bool(original_readme),
+      'prepared_sha256':sha(root/'prepared.json'),'files':[{'path':p,'sha256':sha(repo/p)} for p in paths]}
+    save(evidence/'navigation.json',result);paths.append('coordinator/browsable-copy-01/navigation.json')
+    run(['git','add','--force','--',*paths]);run(['git','diff','--cached','--check','--','coordinator',*(['README.md'] if not original_readme else [])])
+    result['navigation_manifest_sha256']=sha(evidence/'navigation.json');save(root/'navigation.json',result)
+    (root/'prepared-with-navigation.patch').write_text(run(['git','diff','--cached','--binary']).stdout)
+    (root/'prepared-with-navigation-stat.txt').write_text(run(['git','diff','--cached','--stat']).stdout)
+    print(json.dumps({'root_navigation_added':not original_readme,'original_root_readme_preserved':bool(original_readme)}))
+except BaseException:

@@ -0,0 +1,142 @@
+"""Prepare one reviewed browsable copy; only coordinator files are authored."""
+from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
+import hashlib, json, os, shutil, stat, subprocess, sys, traceback
+
+config_path = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
+cfg = json.loads(config_path.read_text())
+root = Path(cfg['root']); repo = root / 'publisher'; repo.mkdir()
+main = Path('/Users/johnlee/code/CON/stamped-in-practice')
+pixi = ['pixi', 'run', '--manifest-path', str(main/'pixi.toml'), '--locked']
+host = json.loads(Path('/Users/johnlee/.config/stamped-in-practice/launch-neutral.json').read_text())
+canonical = cfg['canonical']; commands = []
+assert cfg['run_id'] != 'narps-neutral-r1-20'
+
+def sha(path):
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open('rb') as stream:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024*1024), b''): h.update(chunk)
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+def save(path, value): path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True)+'\n')
+
+def run(argv, allow=False, _retry=False):
+    p = subprocess.run(list(map(str, argv)), cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True)
+    commands.append({'argv':list(map(str, argv)), 'cwd':str(repo), 'returncode':p.returncode,
+                     'stdout':p.stdout, 'stderr':p.stderr})
+    save(root/'commands-prepare.json', commands)
+    if not _retry and p.returncode == 128 and 'ssh: connect to host github.com port 22: Operation timed out' in p.stderr and argv[:2] in [['git','fetch'],['git','ls-remote'],['git','push']]: return run(argv, allow, True)
+    if not allow: p.check_returncode()
+    return p
+
+try:
+    plan_path = Path(cfg['plan_path']); assert sha(plan_path) == cfg['plan_sha256']
+    plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text()); capture = Path(plan['capture_manifest']['path'])
+    assert plan['run_id'] == cfg['run_id'] == canonical['run_id']
+    assert sha(capture) == plan['capture_manifest']['sha256'] == canonical['capture_sha256']
+    assert plan['original_worker_head'] == canonical['worker_head_commit']
+    source_entries = {e['path']:e for e in json.loads(capture.read_text())['entries']}
+    inputs_path = Path(cfg['input_manifest_path']); route_path = Path(cfg['input_route_proof_path'])
+    assert sha(inputs_path) == cfg['input_manifest_sha256']
+    assert sha(route_path) == cfg['input_route_proof_sha256']
+    inputs = json.loads(inputs_path.read_text()); route = json.loads(route_path.read_text())
+    assert route['verified'] and route['input_files_verified'] == len(inputs['files']) == 58
+    assert route['input_manifest_sha256'] == cfg['input_manifest_sha256']
+    assert inputs['input_tree'] == canonical['input_tree']
+    run(['git','init','--initial-branch',cfg['branch']])
+    run(['git','remote','add','origin','git@github.com:leej3/stamped-in-practice.git'])
+    run(['git','config','remote.origin.annex-ignore','true'])
+    run(['git','fetch','--no-tags','origin',canonical['commit']])
+    run(['git','reset','--hard','FETCH_HEAD'])
+    assert run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).stdout.strip() == canonical['commit']
+    assert not (repo/'.git/objects/info/alternates').exists()
+    assert run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD:input']).stdout.strip() == inputs['input_tree']
+    assert run(['git','rev-parse',canonical['worker_head_commit']+':input']).stdout.strip() == inputs['input_tree']
+    run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',canonical['worker_head_commit'],'HEAD'])
+    assert sha(repo/'coordinator/original-manifest.json') == canonical['capture_sha256']
+    assert sha(repo/'coordinator/delivery-01/index.json') == canonical['package_index_sha256']
+    archive_tree = run(['git','ls-tree','HEAD','coordinator/delivery-01/delivery.tar.gz']).stdout
+    original_readme = run(['git','ls-tree','HEAD','README.md']).stdout
+    run(pixi+['git','annex','init',cfg['run_id']+' browsable coordinator copy'])
+    run(['git','remote','add',host['annex_remote'],host['annex_git_url']])
+    run(['git','config','remote.'+host['annex_remote']+'.annexurl',host['annex_url']])
+    run(['git','fetch','origin','git-annex:refs/remotes/origin/git-annex'])
+    run(pixi+['git','annex','merge'])
+    assert run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).stdout.strip() == canonical['commit']
+    # Preflight the complete reviewed plan before copying any original files.
+    for e in plan['entries']:
+        path = PurePosixPath(e['path']); assert not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts
+        assert not any(c in e['path'] for c in '\n\r\0*?[]'), 'Unreviewed attribute pattern'
+        assert e['capture_path'] == 'content/workspace/'+e['path']
+        source = source_entries[e['capture_path']]
+        assert all(source.get(k) == e.get(k) for k in ['kind','mode','sha256','size','target'])
+        assert e['action'] in ['directory-no-placeholder','copy-to-git','copy-to-annex','preserve-literal-link']
+        dest = repo/e['path']; src = capture.parent/e['capture_path']
+        assert not dest.exists() and not dest.is_symlink(), 'Publisher collision: '+e['path']
+        assert stat.S_IMODE(src.lstat().st_mode) == e['mode']
+        if e['kind'] == 'file':
+            assert stat.S_ISREG(src.lstat().st_mode) and sha(src) == e['sha256'] and src.stat().st_size == e['size']
+        elif e['kind'] == 'symlink': assert os.readlink(src) == e['target']
+        else: assert e['kind'] == 'directory' and stat.S_ISDIR(src.lstat().st_mode)
+    copied = []
+    for e in plan['entries']:
+        if e['action'] == 'directory-no-placeholder': continue
+        dest = repo/e['path']; src = capture.parent/e['capture_path']; dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        row = {'original_path':e['path'],'published_path':e['path'],'kind':e['kind'],'source_mode':e['mode']}
+        if e['kind'] == 'symlink':
+            os.symlink(e['target'], dest); row.update(storage='literal-link',target=e['target'])
+        else:
+            with src.open('rb') as source, dest.open('xb') as target: shutil.copyfileobj(source,target)
+            os.chmod(dest,e['mode']); assert sha(dest) == sha(src) == e['sha256']
+            row.update(bytes=e['size'],sha256=e['sha256'],storage='annex' if e['action']=='copy-to-annex' else 'git')
+        copied.append(row)
+    with (repo/'.gitattributes').open('a') as stream:
+        stream.write('\n# Coordinator presentation copies; original scientific bytes unchanged.\n')
+        for e in copied:
+            stream.write(json.dumps('/'+e['published_path'])+' annex.largefiles='+('anything annex.backend=SHA256E' if e['storage']=='annex' else 'nothing')+'\n')
+    annex = [e['published_path'] for e in copied if e['storage']=='annex']
+    if annex: run(pixi+['git','annex','add','--force-large','--backend=SHA256E','--',*annex])
+    for e in copied:
+        if e['storage']=='annex': e['annex_key']=run(pixi+['git','annex','lookupkey',e['published_path']]).stdout.strip()
+    evidence = repo/'coordinator/browsable-copy-01'; evidence.mkdir()
+    shutil.copy2(plan_path,evidence/'plan.json'); shutil.copy2(inputs_path,evidence/'input-manifest.json')
+    shutil.copy2(route_path,evidence/'shared-input-route-proof.json'); shutil.copy2(config_path,evidence/'config.json')
+    shutil.copy2(Path(__file__),evidence/'prepare.py')
+    manifest = {'schema':'coordinator-browsable-copy-v1','run_id':cfg['run_id'],'parent_commit':canonical['commit'],
+      'source_worker_head':plan['original_worker_head'],'capture_sha256':sha(capture),'plan_sha256':sha(plan_path),
+      'copied_files':copied,'authoritative_archive':'../delivery-01/delivery.tar.gz','authoritative_capture':'../original-manifest.json',
+      'attribution':'Coordinator presentation copies of exact original stopped files; no worker credit or scientific execution.',
+      'source_files_unchanged':True,'scientific_execution':False,'input_tree':inputs['input_tree'],
+      'shared_input_route_proof_sha256':sha(route_path),'shared_input_manifest_sha256':sha(inputs_path),
+      'shared_input_route_published_commit':cfg['input_route_published_proof_commit'],
+      'input_verification_scope':'Exact Git input tree matches prior independently retrieved 58-payload input manifest; payloads not redundantly downloaded for this presentation.',
+      'mode_scope':'Original full modes retained here and in authoritative archive; Git preserves executable bits and literal links, annex preserves payload bytes.'}
+    save(evidence/'manifest.json',manifest)
+    with (repo/'coordinator/README.md').open('a') as stream:
+        stream.write('\n## Browsable original files\n\nOriginal scientific files are also available at their unchanged workspace paths. '
+          'The [copy manifest](browsable-copy-01/manifest.json) records exact source hashes, original modes and storage choices. '
+          'These are coordinator presentation copies; the complete archive remains authoritative. '
+          'The input tree matches the [shared retrieval proof](browsable-copy-01/shared-input-route-proof.json); '
+          'its 58 payloads were independently retrieved in the cited run 20 check. '
+          'No scientific execution or worker credit is implied.\n')
+    cmd=pixi+['pre-commit','run','--config',str(main/'.pre-commit-config.yaml'),'snapper','--files','coordinator/README.md']
+    if run(cmd,allow=True).returncode: run(cmd)
+    run(['git','add','--force','--','.gitattributes','coordinator/README.md','coordinator/browsable-copy-01',*[e['published_path'] for e in copied]])
+    run(['git','diff','--cached','--check','--','.gitattributes','coordinator'])
+    assert run(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only','--','input','coordinator/delivery-01','coordinator/original-manifest.json']).stdout == ''
+    for e in copied:
+        path=e['published_path']; mode=run(['git','ls-files','--stage','--',path]).stdout.split()[0]
+        expected='120000' if e['storage'] in ['annex','literal-link'] else ('100755' if e['source_mode']&0o111 else '100644')
+        assert mode == expected
+        if e['kind']=='file': assert sha(repo/path) == e['sha256']
+        else: assert os.readlink(repo/path) == e['target']
+    assert sha(capture) == canonical['capture_sha256']
+    assert run(['git','ls-tree','HEAD','coordinator/delivery-01/delivery.tar.gz']).stdout == archive_tree
+    if not any(e['published_path']=='README.md' for e in copied):
+        assert run(['git','ls-tree','HEAD','README.md']).stdout == original_readme
+    diff=run(['git','diff','--cached','--stat']).stdout; (root/'prepared-diff-stat.txt').write_text(diff)
+    (root/'prepared.patch').write_text(run(['git','diff','--cached','--binary']).stdout)
+    save(root/'prepared.json',dict(manifest,publisher=str(repo),branch=cfg['branch'],annex_files=annex,
+       package_index_sha256=canonical['package_index_sha256'],plan_path=str(plan_path),config_sha256=sha(config_path)))
+    print(json.dumps({'prepared':True,'run_id':cfg['run_id'],'files':len(copied),'annex_files':len(annex),'committed':False}))
+except BaseException:
+    (root/'failure-prepare.txt').write_text(traceback.format_exc()); raise

+# Potential gains and brain activity in the equal-indifference group
+
+## Question and result
+
+Among the 54 participants in NARPS's equal-indifference group, the supplied gain-effect maps do **not** provide whole-brain family-wise corrected evidence for a gain-related increase in vmPFC. Twenty-three voxels in three small posterior occipital-pole clusters passed the one-sided whole-brain max-statistic permutation test (α = .05; peak t = 6.62 at MNI [-26, -102, -3.6], max-T FWE p = .0006); none were in vmPFC. In an independently defined vmPFC mask, the mean participant effect was **-0.009** (95% t interval **[-0.040, 0.022]**), and no voxel survived whole-brain correction. The occipital finding does not support the vmPFC hypothesis. A lack of vmPFC support is not evidence that the true effect is exactly zero.
+
+![Uncorrected positive whole-brain group t map; inference uses whole-brain max-T correction](figures/whole_brain_t_uncorrected.png)
+
+*Figure 1. Positive-direction one-sample t statistics displayed at uncorrected p < .05 for visualization only. There were 7,326 such voxels; only 23 voxels in posterior occipital-pole clusters passed whole-brain correction.*
+
+![Whole-brain max-T FWE corrected positive gain effects](figures/whole_brain_fwe.png)
+
+*Figure 2. The corrected map shows the small posterior occipital-pole clusters that survive whole-brain FWE; no vmPFC voxels survive.*
+
+![Participant vmPFC estimates](figures/vmPFC_subject_estimates.png)
+
+*Figure 3. Each point is one participant's average effect estimate across voxels in the anatomical vmPFC mask. The interval is a descriptive 95% t interval for the group mean; inferential support is determined by whole-brain correction.*
+
+## Methods
+
+I analyzed all supplied participants as the independent units in a one-sample, positive-direction group t test of participant gain-effect estimates against zero. Input maps were finite, and shared shape and affine were confirmed. The analysis mask was the intersection of voxels with nonzero finite values in all 54 maps and a resampled standard MNI152 brain mask (186,400 voxels); this common-support rule avoids comparing different participant coverage while restricting inference to brain. No participants were excluded. Whole-brain family-wise error was controlled with 10,000 participant-level sign-flip permutations and the maximum t statistic across the complete analysis mask (fixed seed 20261016; minimum attainable p = 1/10,001). Whole-brain correction addresses false positives across locations, at a power cost compared with an ROI-only test.
+
+I localized vmPFC using the Harvard-Oxford cortical atlas (25% maximum-probability map), taking its *Frontal Medial Cortex* label at MNI y ≥ 0 and z ≤ 0 (769 voxels on the input grid). This atlas-defined ventral medial subset is an anatomical aid, not a mask used to select the whole-brain inference. vmPFC boundaries vary across conventions; the anatomical summary is therefore descriptive.
+
+## Interpretation and limits
+
+These are participant contrast parameter estimates (COPEs), not z/t maps or group statistics. The upstream gain modulator was mean-centered and variance-normalized before HRF convolution, so its coefficient is not response change per currency unit. The response was modeled with response-time durations and separate choice and gain modulators; nonresponses, motion, flagged volumes, drift, and run combination follow the fixed upstream analysis. Gain and loss were estimated in separate models, so the gain coefficient is conditional on that modeling choice. In the task, potential gains varied over twice the range of potential losses, which further cautions against interpreting this coefficient as an isolated monetary-unit slope.
+
+The one-sample model gives equal weight to each participant because participant variance maps were not supplied. Thus group uncertainty cannot account for differences in first-level precision, and the variance of the COPEs mixes true participant differences with estimation error. Sign-flip inference assumes participant-level errors are symmetric under the null. The data support conclusions only about this selected group, these supplied maps, and this upstream model. Failure to reject does not rule out a smaller positive effect, effects with a different spatial extent, or effects under a different first-level specification; it also does not establish absence of vmPFC involvement.
+
+## Reproducibility
+
+Run `python analysis/group_analysis.py` in the supplied Python environment from this workspace. The script writes group maps, voxelwise p values, QC summaries, and figures. `results/summary.json` contains the key numerical results; `results/participant_qc.tsv` records participant coverage and map summaries. The original study's Hypothesis 1 instructions are available [here](https://www.narps.info/files/narps_instructions_for_analysis_teams.pdf).
